verdict.rationale: The model docs say the system automatically falls back to Universal-2 for languages outside the primary set 'without any extra configuration.' That implies AssemblyAI can handle a language without the developer declaring it, but no evidence explicitly documents a spoken-language detection feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic language detection (e.g., a detection parameter or detected-language output), confidence scores or detection behavior, coverage for streaming as well as pre-recorded audio, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it

citations.quote: for anything outside that set, the system automatically falls back to Universal-2, giving you coverage across 99 languages total without any extra configuration.
Transcribes recorded audio and video asynchronously across 99 languages
